newsitem.title: USA: Nordson sues Graco over patent.
newsitem.headline: Nordson sues Graco over patent.

text.p: Nordson Corp said Wednesday it filed suit against Graco Inc for alleged patent infringement of its Pro-Flo dispensing systems.
The case was filed against the Minneapolis-based comnpany in a federal district court in Ohio, Nordson said.
A Graco spokesman said his company had no comment to make at this time.
Nordson, a maker of adhesives, sealants and coatings, said that its Pro-Flo system is a pioneering technology used by the automotive industry to apply adhesives and sealants in the assembly process.
It said it has asked the court for an injunction to stop Graco's alleged infringement on its patent, for damages and for the destruction of Graco's infringing devices.
